rubric.en: minor issues: a documented shim, mild bloat
rubric.zh: 小问题：有文档的兼容、轻微臃肿
明显的 hack / 回退 / 臃肿 / 重复

rubric.en: significant legacy / stubs / duplication, or a protocol violation
rubric.zh: 严重的遗留 / 占位 / 重复，或协议违规
损坏、伪造输出，或未完成却已接线

severities.en: wrong / dangerous / fake, a protocol or security issue, or a genuine maintenance hazard
severities.zh: 错误 / 危险 / 伪造、协议或安全问题，或真正的维护地雷

severities.en: a real smell a maintainer should fix
a documented shim, a cosmetic cast, benign bloat — worth noting, not urgent
severities.zh: 有文档的兼容、装饰性 cast、良性臃肿 —— 值得记、不紧急

coupling.en: system spine — central to almost everything
coupling.zh: 系统主线 —— 几乎牵连一切

tags.label: monkeypatch
tags.en: runtime mutation of another module / stdlib / vendor; reflection or prototype patching
tags.zh: 运行时改写别的模块/标准库/依赖；反射或原型补丁

tags.label: fallback
tags.en: 'try the real thing, then fake/degrade'; a||b||c chains that hide which value is real
tags.zh: “先试真的再退化/造假”；a||b||c 掩盖哪个是真值

tags.label: silent-except
tags.en: swallowed errors: empty catch / except:pass / ignored return codes
tags.zh: 吞掉错误：空 catch / except:pass / 忽略返回码

tags.label: legacy
tags.en: deprecated/back-compat shims, dead-but-shipped code, parallel old+new paths
tags.zh: 遗留/兼容垫片、已发布的死代码、新旧并存

tags.label: dual-format
tags.en: accepting two shapes for one field (snake||camel), patched through the code
tags.zh: 同一字段接受两种形态（snake||camel）并散落各处

tags.label: stub
tags.en: NotImplemented / TODO / dead buttons / demo scripts presented as real
tags.zh: 未实现/TODO/死按钮/演示脚本当成品

tags.label: fake-output
tags.en: returns random/canned/hardcoded results where real work is implied
tags.zh: 本应真算的地方返回随机/写死结果

tags.label: duplication
tags.en: copy-pasted logic, or an existing shared abstraction not reused
tags.zh: 复制粘贴，或已有共享抽象却不复用

tags.label: bloat
tags.en: oversized file / function; too many responsibilities in one unit
tags.zh: 超大文件/函数；单元职责过多

tags.label: glue
tags.en: valueless pass-through: rows of thin forwarders / no-op adapters
tags.zh: 无价值透传：成片薄包装 / 零转换适配器

tags.label: any-escape
tags.en: bypassing the type system: as any / @ts-ignore / dynamic / void* / reinterpret_cast / unsafe
tags.zh: 绕过类型系统：as any / @ts-ignore / dynamic / void* / reinterpret_cast / unsafe

tags.label: over-fit
tags.en: hardcoded to one case where a small generalization was expected
tags.zh: 硬编码单一情况，本应小幅泛化

tags.label: god-component
tags.en: one component/class/file doing far too much
tags.zh: 一个组件/类/文件做太多事

tags.label: placeholder
tags.en: unfinished UI / data presented as if complete
tags.zh: 未完成的 UI/数据当作已完成

tags.label: clean
tags.zh: 无实质问题 —— 职责单一

architectureStatuses.en: not checked or evidence is insufficient
